WITH raw_data AS (
  SELECT 
    timestamp,
    (cpu_package_power + gpu_board_power) AS total_watt,
    COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (timestamp - LAG(timestamp) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp))), 3.0) AS dt
  FROM public.fact_system_hardware
  WHERE timestamp >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AND timestamp <= now()
),
clean_data AS (
  SELECT 
    timestamp,
    total_watt * dt / 3600000.0 AS energy_kwh,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS local_hour
  FROM raw_data
  WHERE dt < 60
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN timestamp >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') THEN energy_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS "今日总能耗",
    SUM(CASE WHEN timestamp >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AND local_hour >= 8 AND local_hour < 22 THEN energy_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS "今日峰电能耗",
    SUM(CASE WHEN timestamp >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AND (local_hour < 8 OR local_hour >= 22) THEN energy_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS "今日谷电能耗"
  FROM clean_data
)
SELECT '今日总能耗 (kWh)' AS metric, ROUND("今日总能耗"::numeric, 3) AS value FROM aggregated
UNION ALL
SELECT '今日峰电能耗 (08-22h)', ROUND("今日峰电能耗"::numeric, 3) FROM aggregated
UNION ALL
SELECT '今日谷电能耗 (22-08h)', ROUND("今日谷电能耗"::numeric, 3) FROM aggregated;

  WHERE dt < 60

  SELECT
    energy_kwh,
    timestamp,
    CASE WHEN local_hour >= 8 AND local_hour < 22 THEN energy_kwh * ${peak_price} ELSE energy_kwh * ${valley_price} END AS cost
  FROM clean_data
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN timestamp >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS "今日电费",
    SUM(CASE WHEN timestamp >= date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') THEN cost ELSE 0 END) AS "本周电费",
    SUM(cost) AS "本月累计",
    (SUM(cost) / GREATEST(1.0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')))/3600.0) * 
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') + interval '1 month' - date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')))/3600.0) AS "月底预测"
  FROM prices
)
SELECT '今日已花电费' AS metric, ROUND("今日电费"::numeric, 2) AS value FROM aggregated
UNION ALL
SELECT '本周累计电费', ROUND("本周电费"::numeric, 2) FROM aggregated
UNION ALL
SELECT '本月累计电费', ROUND("本月累计"::numeric, 2) FROM aggregated
UNION ALL
SELECT '💡 本月预测花费', ROUND("月底预测"::numeric, 2) FROM aggregated;

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_hw AS (
  SELECT 
    cpu_package_power,
    gpu_board_power,
    cpu_total_usage,
    gpu_usage
  FROM public.fact_system_hardware WHERE timestamp >= now() - interval '1 hour' AND timestamp <= now() ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
),
estimation AS (
  SELECT 
    -- 12V 外设：15W - 50W
    15.0 + (cpu_total_usage / 100.0 * 15.0) + (gpu_usage / 100.0 * 20.0) AS p12v_periph_watt,
    -- 5V 外设 (USB/RGB)：20W - 80W
    20.0 + (cpu_total_usage / 100.0 * 30.0) + (gpu_usage / 100.0 * 30.0) AS p5v_watt,
    -- 3.3V 外设 (主板/M.2)：10W - 20W
    10.0 + (cpu_total_usage / 100.0 * 10.0) AS p3_3v_watt,
    cpu_package_power + gpu_board_power AS dc_chips_watt
  FROM latest_hw
),
calculation AS (
  SELECT 
    dc_chips_watt + p12v_periph_watt + p5v_watt + p3_3v_watt AS dc_total_watt,
    (dc_chips_watt + p12v_periph_watt + p5v_watt + p3_3v_watt) / 1000.0 * 100.0 AS psu_load_pct
  FROM estimation
),
ac_calculation AS (
  SELECT 
    dc_total_watt,
    psu_load_pct,
    CASE 
      WHEN dc_total_watt < 100 THEN 0.85
      WHEN dc_total_watt < 250 THEN 0.89
      WHEN dc_total_watt < 600 THEN 0.91
      ELSE 0.89
    END AS psu_efficiency
  FROM calculation
),
final_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    dc_total_watt / psu_efficiency AS ac_wall_watt,
    psu_load_pct,
    (dc_total_watt / psu_efficiency) / 220.0 AS ac_current_amp
  FROM ac_calculation
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(ac_wall_watt::numeric, 1) AS "⚡ 估算墙上输入功耗", 
  ROUND(psu_load_pct::numeric, 1) AS "🔌 1000W电源负载率", 
  ROUND(ac_current_amp::numeric, 2) AS "🔌 220V输入电流估算" 
FROM final_metrics;

WITH latest_hw AS (

  CASE 
    WHEN load_pct_5v < 50.0 THEN '✅ 供电安全'
    WHEN load_pct_5v < 80.0 THEN '⚠️ 供电吃紧'
    ELSE '🔥 供电危险'
  END AS "💚 供电状态"

WITH time_bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS range_start,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS range_end
),
interval_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', make_interval(secs => ceil(extract(epoch from (b.range_end - b.range_start)) / 2000)::int)) AS dt
  FROM time_bounds b
),
time_grid AS (
  SELECT g.grid_time
  FROM time_bounds b
  CROSS JOIN interval_calc i
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from b.range_start) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from b.range_end) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    i.dt
  ) g(grid_time)
),
hw_aligned AS (
  SELECT 
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from timestamp) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz AS bucket_time,
    AVG(cpu_package_power) AS cpu_power,
    AVG(gpu_board_power) AS gpu_power,
    AVG(30.0 + (cpu_package_power + gpu_board_power) * 0.12) AS platform_power
  FROM public.fact_system_hardware
  CROSS JOIN time_bounds b
  CROSS JOIN interval_calc i
  WHERE timestamp >= b.range_start AND timestamp <= b.range_end
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  g.grid_time as time,
  ad.cpu_power AS "CPU 功耗 (W)",
  ad.gpu_power AS "GPU 功耗 (W)",
  ad.platform_power AS "外设/主板估算 (W)",
  (ad.cpu_power + ad.gpu_power + ad.platform_power) AS "实时整机总功耗 (W)"
FROM time_grid g
LEFT JOIN hw_aligned ad ON ad.bucket_time = g.grid_time
ORDER BY 1;

  )::numeric, 2) AS "电费花费 (元)"
FROM attributed_power

WITH time_bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t_from,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS t_to
),
hw_ticks AS (
  SELECT 
    timestamp,
    cpu_package_power,
    gpu_board_power,
    current_fps,
    COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (timestamp - LAG(timestamp) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp))), 3.0) AS dt
  FROM public.fact_system_hardware, time_bounds
  WHERE timestamp >= t_from AND timestamp <= t_to
),
hw_clean AS (
  SELECT *, (cpu_package_power + gpu_board_power) * dt / 3600000.0 AS energy_kwh
  FROM hw_ticks
  WHERE dt < 60
),
daily_energy AS (
  SELECT 
    date_trunc('day', timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS bucket_day,
    SUM(energy_kwh) AS daily_kwh
  FROM hw_clean
  GROUP BY 1
),
daily_efficiency AS (
  SELECT 
    date_trunc('day', timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS bucket_day,
    AVG(current_fps) / NULLIF(AVG(cpu_package_power + gpu_board_power), 0) * 1000.0 AS fps_per_kilojoule
  FROM hw_clean
  WHERE current_fps > 10
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  (m.bucket_day AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS "time",
  m.daily_kwh AS "每日总能耗 (kWh)",
  ROUND(e.fps_per_kilojoule::numeric, 2) AS "游戏能效比 (帧/千焦耳)"
FROM daily_energy m
LEFT JOIN daily_efficiency e ON m.bucket_day = e.bucket_day
ORDER BY 1;

targets.rawSql:
WITH raw_data AS (
  SELECT 
    timestamp,
    (cpu_package_power + gpu_board_power) AS total_watt,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS hr,
    COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (timestamp - LAG(timestamp) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp))), 3.0) AS dt
  FROM public.fact_system_hardware
  WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
),
hourly_energy AS (
  SELECT 
    hr,
    total_watt * dt / 3600000.0 AS energy_kwh,
    CASE 
      WHEN hr >= 8 AND hr < 22 THEN 'peak'
      ELSE 'valley'
    END AS period
  FROM raw_data
  WHERE dt < 60
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'peak' THEN energy_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS peak_kwh,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'valley' THEN energy_kwh ELSE 0 END) AS valley_kwh
  FROM hourly_energy
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(peak_kwh::numeric, 2) AS "⚡ 峰电用量 (kWh)",
  ROUND((peak_kwh * ${peak_price})::numeric, 2) AS "💰 峰电电费 (元)",
  ROUND(valley_kwh::numeric, 2) AS "🌙 谷电用量 (kWh)",
  ROUND((valley_kwh * ${valley_price})::numeric, 2) AS "💰 谷电电费 (元)"
FROM stats;
